issues.message: Date chronology violation detected. Admission date (2025-10-09) is AFTER patient's date of birth (1969-10-24), but discharge date (2025-10-27) creates impossible timeline. Patient would be 55 years old at surgery (2025-10-10), but DOB shows 1969-10-24. This indicates date format confusion: 24/10/1969 was correctly interpreted as DD/MM/YYYY (October 24, 1969), but surgery/discharge dates in 2025 are temporally impossible - patient cannot have surgery in future. The dates 10/10/2025 and 27/10/2025 should likely be 10/10/2024 and 27/10/2024 (year 2024, not 2025).
issues.suggestedFix: Review source notes to verify year. If notes show 2025, this is likely a documentation error. Surgery date should be 2024-10-10 (making patient 54-55 years old at surgery). Rerun extraction with corrected year or flag for manual review.
